title: 輪胎結構與製造品質
summary: 從材料與硫化到均勻性和滾阻，將充氣條件、接地壓力與耐久試驗分開。
summaryEn: Move from materials/cure to uniformity and rolling resistance, separating inflation, contact pressure and durability.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 輪胎平均接地壓力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mean tire contact pressure: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 輪胎平均接地壓力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mean tire contact pressure and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為輪胎胎體、胎面及足跡。平均接地壓力不是每點相同的實際壓力，胎體剛性與花紋會改變分布。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows tire carcass, tread and footprint. Mean contact pressure is not uniform local pressure; carcass stiffness and tread change its distribution.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：p=F/A；F=4000 N、A=.02 m²；計算結果=200 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: p=F/A; F=4000 N, A=.02 m²; result=200 kPa.
steps.failure: 偏磨可能來自定位、載重或胎壓；比較左右足跡與輪胎歷史。
steps.failureEn: Uneven wear may reflect alignment, load or pressure; compare left/right footprints and tire history.
steps.check: 平均200 kPa；不應把此計算當充氣壓力建議。 將此判讀連回輪胎胎體、胎面及足跡的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Mean pressure is 200 kPa and is not an inflation recommendation. Relate this interpretation to tire carcass, tread and footprint and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為輪胎胎體、胎面及足跡。簡化滾阻係數描述輪胎變形耗能；胎壓、溫度與速度需保留。

steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：Frr=Crr m g；Crr=.01、m=1600 kg、g=9.81 m/s²；計算結果=156.96 N。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Frr=Crr m g; Crr=.01, m=1600 kg, g=9.81 m/s²; result=156.96 N.
steps.failure: 胎壓差與軸承阻力均可增加拖曳力；用空轉與載重試驗分離。

steps.check: 基準156.96 N；比較不同輪胎時須保持載重與條件一致。 將此判讀連回輪胎胎體、胎面及足跡的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Baseline is 156.96 N; tire comparisons need matched loads and conditions. Relate this interpretation to tire carcass, tread and footprint and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

knowledge.textEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Frr=Crr m g; Crr=.01, m=1600 kg, g=9.81 m/s²; result=156.96 N.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在試算表、紙面剖面或自行準備的離線教學模型中：建立同一輪胎不同溫度的假想拖曳力圖，分開起動阻力與穩態滾阻。 交付物：本單元計算表、可重現條件與一項尚無法判定的結論。
knowledge.textEn: Using a worksheet, paper section or an offline teaching model you prepare: Plot synthetic towing force for one tire at different temperatures; separate breakaway from steady rolling. Deliver a calculation sheet, reproducible conditions and one conclusion that the evidence cannot establish.

quiz.question: 依照本單元基準算式，計算結果與單位為何？
quiz.questionEn: What result and unit follow from the baseline expression?
quiz.explanation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：Frr=Crr m g；Crr=.01、m=1600 kg、g=9.81 m/s²；計算結果=156.96 N。 基準156.96 N；比較不同輪胎時須保持載重與條件一致。 將此判讀連回輪胎胎體、胎面及足跡的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
quiz.explanationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Frr=Crr m g; Crr=.01, m=1600 kg, g=9.81 m/s²; result=156.96 N. Baseline is 156.96 N; tire comparisons need matched loads and conditions. Relate this interpretation to tire carcass, tread and footprint and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
